card.name: Final digit 0 or 1 in numbers
card.fires_on: The last digit, usually 0 or 1, that completes a number. It appears in years after a three-digit start like 194 or 144, and after a decimal point in lists of table values.

modes.label: Year ending
modes.description: The final digit 0 or 1 of a four-digit year in the 1400s to 1900s.

modes.label: Table decimals
modes.description: A 0 or 1 after a decimal point in a row of numeric table values.

card.plain: It marks the last digit of a year or a table number, mostly a 0 or 1.
